_meta.note: 一個故事一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Temple Ruin#000.src: Did you open this place up? You've done some serious damage!
Temple Ruin#000.dst: Foi você que abriu este lugar? Você causou um belo estrago!
Temple Ruin#000.speaker: Junes

Temple Ruin#001.src: It might not look like much, but these ruins were left by a now extinct empire.
Temple Ruin#001.dst: Pode não parecer muito, mas estas ruínas são de um império já extinto.
Temple Ruin#001.speaker: Junes

Temple Ruin#002.src: I spent half a year excavating this place.. I must admit it would have taken me {~} years to finish. Alright, let's go deeper. Try to keep up.
Temple Ruin#002.dst: Passei meio ano escavando este lugar.. Admito que levaria {~} anos para terminar. Certo, vamos mais fundo. Tente acompanhar.
Temple Ruin#002.speaker: Junes

Temple Ruin#003.src: Amazing, isn't it? This is just an ordinary building in the old empire that lies beneath the sands.
Temple Ruin#003.dst: Incrível, não? Isto é só um prédio comum do antigo império que jaz sob as areias.
Temple Ruin#003.speaker: Junes

Temple Ruin#004.src: We don't know much about them, but we are uncovering more and more every day.
Temple Ruin#004.dst: Não sabemos muito sobre eles, mas descobrimos mais a cada dia.
Temple Ruin#004.speaker: Junes

Temple Ruin#005.src: Follow me, there is so much to take in.
Temple Ruin#005.speaker: Junes

Temple Ruin#006.src: It's clear that the empire was seriously advanced, possibly more advanced than us in some ways.
Temple Ruin#006.dst: Está claro que o império era muito avançado, talvez mais que nós em alguns aspectos.
Temple Ruin#006.speaker: Junes

Temple Ruin#007.src: I keep seeing symbols in every building.. It looks like some kind of rod or sceptre.
Temple Ruin#007.dst: Vejo símbolos em todos os prédios.. Parece algum tipo de bastão ou cetro.
Temple Ruin#007.speaker: Junes

Temple Ruin#008.src: We know that there was an emperor that ruled these lands, this must be the source of his power.
Temple Ruin#008.dst: Sabemos que um imperador governou estas terras, esta deve ser a fonte do poder dele.
Temple Ruin#008.speaker: Junes

Temple Ruin#009.src: Hmm, I'm going to continue researching this place, but I think I might be able to figure a way out for you.
Temple Ruin#009.dst: Hmm, vou continuar pesquisando este lugar, mas acho que consigo achar uma saída para você.
Temple Ruin#009.speaker: Junes

Temple Ruin#011.src: Howdy feller! This here is my cactus stand.
Temple Ruin#011.dst: E aí, parceiro! Esta aqui é minha barraca de cactos.
Temple Ruin#011.speaker: Cactus Expert

Temple Ruin#012.src: I travel all across the desert, cutting down cactus for the juice!
Temple Ruin#012.dst: Eu viajo pelo deserto inteiro, cortando cactos pelo suco!
Temple Ruin#012.speaker: Cactus Expert

Temple Ruin#013.src: Only the sharpest blades'll cut these cactus though. My collection's out back. You can look, but don't touch!
Temple Ruin#013.dst: Mas só as lâminas mais afiadas cortam esses cactos. Minha coleção tá lá nos fundos. Pode olhar, mas não toque!
Temple Ruin#013.speaker: Cactus Expert
